title: t=0 rejected despite being valid per validation
description:
File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py:80

Falsy timestamp value t=0 is rejected or ignored due to use of `or` operator.

**Failure scenario:** POST {"from": "0102030405060708", "t": 0} returns BAD_REQUEST; POST {"from": "...", "t": 0, "ts": 12345} silently uses ts=12345 instead of t=0.

**Verdict:** CONFIRMED
